newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal demand for EDP stock 20 times supply.
newsitem.headline: Portugal demand for EDP stock 20 times supply.

text.p: Demand for shares in the first pre-registration phase of the coming partial privatisation of state electricity concern EDP-Electricidade de Portugal was some 20 times eventual supply, sources close to the sale said.
Demand in the first phase, which ended on May 28, totalled 3.24 billion shares, they said.
The government plans to privatise around 25 percent, equal to some 150 million shares, of EDP in what will be the biggest privatisation yet carried out in Portugal.
The second period of pre-registration will run from June 9 to 12.
The government has said that the shares will be sold at between 1,750 and 2,250 escudos per share, with the final price and the allocation being fixed at the bourse session set for June 16.
